llm_response.reason: Multiple scam characteristics detected: unusually high discounts (up to 65% off), absence of required legal information for e-commerce in Germany (e.g., no Impressum or actual company details), vague email-only contact with no physical address or company phone, ambiguous privacy information (privacy policy unavailable with an SSL error), and technical/security issues on key pages. The urgency of large discounts and overall lack of transparency are consistent with scam e-commerce operations.
